stepBody: The researcher says, “The value of my observed test statistic is 40% - 48% $$=$$ -8%.” To perform the test, the statistic is simulated under the null hypothesis. One of the figures below is the empirical histogram of the simulated values. Which is it?##figure1.gif##

figureAlts.figure1.gif: (b) The image shows three histograms labeled Histogram (i), Histogram (ii), and Histogram (iii), each displaying the distribution of a simulated statistic. Histogram (i) has a range from -20 to 8 with a peak around -8. Histogram (ii) ranges from 0 to 16 with a peak around 2. Histogram (iii) ranges from -12 to 12 with a peak around -4. Each histogram has the x-axis labeled as Simulated Statistic and the y-axis labeled as Percent per unit.
